entities.summary: Kirby Law is a Canadian former professional ice hockey winger. He played nine games in the National Hockey League with the Philadelphia Flyers over three seasons from 2001 to 2004. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1998 to 2010, was spent in the minor leagues and then in Europe.
